landmarks.name: Badshahi Mosque
landmarks.writeup: A Mughal-era mosque in Lahore, known for its grand architecture and historical significance.

wiki.extract: The Badshahi Mosque is a Mughal-era imperial mosque located in Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan. It was constructed between 1671 and 1673 by the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb, opposite to the Lahore Fort in the northern outskirts of the historic Walled City. It is widely considered to be an iconic landmark of the country.

landmarks.name: Mohenjo-Daro
landmarks.writeup: An ancient Indus Valley Civilization archaeological site, showcasing early urban planning.

wiki.extract: Mohenjo-daro is an archaeological site in the Larkana District of Sindh, Pakistan. Built c. 2500 BCE, it was one of the largest settlements of the ancient Indus Valley Civilisation, and one of the world's earliest major cities, contemporaneous with the civilisations of ancient Egypt, Mesopotamia, Minoa, and Norte Chico.

landmarks.name: Faisal Mosque
landmarks.writeup: The largest mosque in Pakistan, located in Islamabad, notable for its contemporary design.

wiki.extract: The Faisal Mosque is the national mosque of Pakistan, located in Islamabad, the capital of the country. It is the sixth-largest mosque in the world and located on the foothills of Margalla Hills. It is named after the late King Faisal of Saudi Arabia. Designed by Turkish architect Vedat Dalokay, the mosque features a contemporary design consisting of eight sides of concrete shell and is inspired by the design of a typical Bedouin tent.

landmarks.name: K2
landmarks.writeup: The second highest mountain in the world, located in the Karakoram range.

wiki.extract: K2, also known as Mount Godwin-Austen, at 8,611 metres (28,251 ft) above sea level, is the second-highest mountain on Earth, after Mount Everest at 8,849 metres (29,032 ft). It lies in the Karakoram range, partially in the Gilgit-Baltistan region of Pakistan-administered Kashmir and partially in the China-administered Trans-Karakoram Tract in the Taxkorgan Tajik Autonomous County of Xinjiang.

landmarks.name: Lahore Fort
landmarks.writeup: A historic fort in Lahore, reflecting Mughal architecture and history.

wiki.extract: The Lahore Fort is a citadel in the walled interior of Lahore in Punjab, Pakistan. The fortress is located at the northern end of the Walled City and is spread over an area greater than 20 hectares. It contains 21 notable monuments, some of which date to the era of Emperor Akbar. The Lahore Fort is notable for having been almost entirely rebuilt in the 17th century, when the Mughal Empire was at the height of its splendour and opulence.

cultural_events.name: Eid-ul-Fitr
cultural_events.writeup: A major Islamic festival marking the end of Ramadan, celebrated with prayers and feasts.

cultural_events.name: Basant
cultural_events.writeup: A traditional kite-flying festival celebrated mainly in Punjab to welcome spring.

cultural_events.name: Pakistan Day
cultural_events.writeup: Commemorates the Lahore Resolution of 1940, celebrated with parades and ceremonies.

food_writeup: Pakistani cuisine is rich and diverse, featuring dishes like biryani, kebabs, nihari, and various breads such as naan and roti, reflecting regional flavors and spices.
brief_history: Pakistan was established in 1947 as a separate nation for Muslims following the partition of British India. It has a complex history involving cultural diversity, political changes, and regional conflicts.

important_people.name: Benazir Bhutto
important_people.description: First female Prime Minister of Pakistan

current_conflicts: Ongoing tensions with India primarily over the Kashmir region, internal security challenges related to militant groups, and political instability.
